summary: Arcos Dorados Holdings Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports revenues of $2.52 billion, operating income of $135.4 million, and net income attributable to the company of $81.1 million. This is a routine periodic report of financial results, not a special-situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is purely informational, providing financial performance updates for investors.
